email.verification.subject: Your TezFarmo verification code
email.verification.heading: Email verification
email.verification.intro: Hello {name}, use this code to confirm your email address for TezFarmo.
email.verification.instruction: Enter this 6-digit code on the TezFarmo verification page.
email.verification.expiry: The code works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
email.verification.ignore: If you didn't create a TezFarmo account, ignore this email; nothing will change.
email.password_reset.subject: Your TezFarmo password reset code
email.password_reset.heading: Reset your password
email.password_reset.intro: Hello {name}, we received a request to reset the password of your TezFarmo account.
email.password_reset.instruction: Enter this 6-digit code on the TezFarmo password reset page to choose a new password.
email.password_reset.expiry: The code works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. After the reset you will be signed out of all devices.
email.password_reset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email; your password stays the same.

email.account_exists.heading: You already have an account
email.account_exists.intro: Hello {name}, someone tried to register a new TezFarmo account with this email address. An account with this address already exists, so nothing was created.
email.account_exists.expiry: Forgot your password? Use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page.
email.account_exists.ignore: If it wasn't you, ignore this email; your account is not affected.
